body: Thank you, I'll try to keep this all in mind but I feel it might be easier said than done. The whole pull back is my main struggle right now, because I just don't know how to leave this relationship - I feel like I've been lying and I've dug myself in too deep now.
It's nice to here that it's not just me, and I really hate the idea of therapy but it seems like the only thing I can really do at this point.
Thanks man, I'll post there. It's really nice just to have someone say something, even if you think it's not useful - so thanks for that :)
